rationale: The Latin anchor 'follis' specifically means a bellows (an air-blowing device), and 'uter' (a leather bag/skin) and 'bulga' (leather bag) further confirm a physical, bag-like implement. This aligns directly with bellows.n.01 as a mechanical device for blowing air, matching the concrete, tool-related sense of OE BELG in the glossary attestations.
